content: There is no "Thunderbird email password". Are you referring to your email provider's password? If so, there's a slight possibility, depending on how your email account is set up, that you can view their password in Saved Passwords (see <Accounts | Privacy & Security | Passwords | Saved Passwords>.) If you don't find it there and you have no other record of it, you will probably have to reset your password on your email provider's web site.

content:
Lacking a backup, my personal approach would be this:

  1. backup the profile
  2. download from thunderbird.net and reinstall
  3. set the account up but without password
  4. Locate the POP account in old profile (would be in the mail folder). NOTE: if there is more than one profile in the profile folder, check dates on each to ensure you pick the active one)
  5. with thunderbird not running, copy POP folder to overwrite the POP folder in the profile
  6. restart and enter password.
